pictures.name: SA1-Dusty-Field
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A quiet dusty plain below the hills of Anandpur after a day of fighting, late afternoon haze. Tired, thirsty soldiers in old Punjabi and Mughal-era dress rest and lie on the dry ground, some propped against rocks, some on both sides of the field, weary but peaceful. No blood, no injuries visible, no weapons raised. Gold dust in the light, deep blue hills.

pictures.name: SA2-Water-Bag
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Bhai Ghanaiya, a kind old Sikh with a long white beard, a white turban and simple white clothes, a heavy leather water bag slung on his shoulder, kneels on the dusty field and pours water from a small brass cup to the lips of a tired soldier resting on the ground. Tender, gentle, warm gold light. No blood or injury.

pictures.name: SA3-Both-Sides
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. The same kind old Sikh with a long white beard, white turban and leather water bag kneels beside a tired soldier from the other army, in a Mughal-style padded coat and a different turban, holding the brass cup to his lips. The soldier looks up at him in surprise and gratitude. Gentle late gold light, dust in the air. No blood or injury.

pictures.name: SA4-Before-The-Guru
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. An open camp courtyard at dusk. A small group of angry Sikh soldiers point at the kind old Sikh with a long white beard, white turban and leather water bag, who stands calm and humble with palms joined. They face a regal figure in royal blue with a tall turban, seated on a low platform, seen only from behind, his face never visible. Lamps glow, blue twilight.

pictures.name: SA6-Ardas-Today

A congregation of men, women and children, heads covered, stands with palms joined, facing the front where the scripture rests under a rich embroidered canopy on a raised platform, seen from a distance.
